items.t: Severe frame rust
items.job: Replace frame and transfer body, suspension and lines
items.note: Toyota's old frame program has mostly ended, but ask a dealer with your VIN. A used frame costs less.

items.t: Front lower ball joint can separate
items.job: Replace front lower ball joints (both sides) and align
items.note: Covered by a recall on 2001-2004 trucks. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Spare tire carrier can rust and drop the spare
items.job: Replace spare tire carrier or lift plate
items.note: Covered by a recall on 2001-2004 trucks. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Frame rust-through
items.job: Replace frame and transfer body, suspension and lines
items.note: Older frame coverage has mostly ended, but ask a dealer with your VIN. Rusted brake lines add cost.

items.t: Excess frame corrosion in salt states
items.job: Clean, treat and rustproof frame
items.note: Ask a Toyota dealer about the frame corrosion campaign. If the frame is perforated, replacement costs far more.

items.t: Rear leaf spring can break
items.job: Replace both rear leaf spring assemblies
items.note: Recall 14V604 covers many 2005-2011 trucks. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Rear leaf springs squeak
items.job: Install updated rear leaf spring silencer pads

items.t: Clunk or bump when starting or stopping
items.job: Clean and grease driveshaft slip joint
items.note: If the slip joint is worn, the driveshaft may need replacing, which costs more.

items.t: Driveshaft U-joint vibration
items.job: Replace driveshaft U-joints
items.note: Ask a dealer whether any driveshaft support program still covers your VIN.

items.t: Steering shaft rattle
items.job: Replace intermediate steering shaft

items.t: Headlight lens melting or bubbling
items.job: Replace headlight assembly
items.note: Price is per side. Ask a dealer whether the extended headlight warranty still applies.

items.t: Secondary air injection pump failure
items.job: Replace secondary air pump and switching valve
items.note: Sometimes only the switching valve is needed. Ask a dealer whether extended coverage still applies.

items.t: Rear differential can leak and lock up
items.job: Reseal rear differential carrier and refill gear oil
items.note: Recall covers 2016-2017 trucks. If the differential was damaged, replacement costs much more.

items.t: Differential whine or grinding
items.job: Rebuild or replace rear differential gears and bearings
items.note: A dealer may first try a bulletin repair. Used differential units cost less.

items.t: Brake master cylinder can leak inside
items.job: Replace brake master cylinder and bleed brakes
items.note: Recall covers many 2018-2019 trucks. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Automatic hunts for gears or engages late
items.job: Reprogram engine and transmission control software
items.note: A software update is the usual fix. It may be free if the truck is still under warranty.

items.t: Suspension squeaks and howls
items.job: Install updated rear spring pads per bulletin

items.t: Rear axle shaft can come loose
items.job: Inspect rear axle, tighten nuts, replace damaged parts
items.note: Recall covers 2022-2023 trucks. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Rear brake hose can be damaged by mud
items.job: Replace both rear brake hoses and bleed brakes
items.note: Recall covers 2024-2025 4WD trucks. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Front driveshaft CV joint can break
items.job: Replace front driveshaft assemblies
items.note: Recall covers 2025 trucks. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Shock absorber reservoir can corrode off
items.job: Replace front and rear shock absorbers
items.note: Recall covers 2024-2025 trucks; the final fix is phased. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.
